title: Oven Roasted Middle Eastern Chicken Musakhan
description: A spicy and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring chicken and sumac, roasted to perfection in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sumac, olive oil, white wine vinegar, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the sumac mixture.
Heat a large ceramic tagine over medium-high heat and add the chicken, cooking until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced onion to the tagine and cook until it starts to caramelize.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and roast for 30 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Return the tagine to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
